sub_graphs.title: Fulu P2P: Data Column Sidecar Gossip Validation Pipeline
sub_graphs.description: Models the sequential validation pipeline that data column sidecars must pass through when received via gossip, including structural checks, cryptographic verification, and fork-choice consistency checks.

nodes.label: Data Column Sidecar Received via Gossip
nodes.description: A data_column_sidecar message has been received on subnet data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} but not yet validated

nodes.label: Verify Structural Validity
nodes.description: Run verify_data_column_sidecar(sidecar): check sidecar.index < NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS, len(kzg_commitments) > 0, len(kzg_commitments) <= max_blobs_per_block, and column/commitments/proofs length consistency

nodes.label: Verify Correct Subnet Routing
nodes.description: Check compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(sidecar.index) == subnet_id to ensure the sidecar is on the correct gossip subnet

nodes.label: Check Slot Timeliness
nodes.description: Verify block_header.slot <= current_slot (with MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY allowance) to ignore future sidecars

nodes.label: Check Slot Above Finalization
nodes.description: Verify block_header.slot > compute_start_slot_at_epoch(state.finalized_checkpoint.epoch) to ignore already-finalized slots

nodes.label: Verify Proposer Signature
nodes.description: Validate the proposer signature on sidecar.signed_block_header

nodes.label: Check Parent Block Seen
nodes.description: Verify parent block has been seen via gossip or non-gossip sources; ignore if not

nodes.label: Verify Parent Passes Validation
nodes.description: Reject if parent block does not pass validation

nodes.label: Check Slot Higher Than Parent
nodes.description: Reject if sidecar slot is not strictly greater than parent slot

nodes.label: Check Finalized Checkpoint Ancestry
nodes.description: Verify get_checkpoint_block(store, parent_root, finalized_epoch) == finalized_root to ensure fork-choice consistency

nodes.label: Verify KZG Commitments Inclusion Proof
nodes.description: Run verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof: Merkle branch verification that kzg_commitments are included in block body_root at depth 4

nodes.label: Verify KZG Column Proofs
nodes.description: Run verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs: batch cell KZG proof verification of column data against commitments

nodes.label: Check Anti-Equivocation Uniqueness
nodes.description: Ignore if not the first valid sidecar for tuple (slot, proposer_index, column_index) with valid signature, inclusion proof, and KZG proof

nodes.label: Verify Expected Proposer Index
nodes.description: Reject if proposer_index does not match expected proposer for block slot in shuffling context defined by parent_root/slot. May queue if not immediately verifiable.

nodes.label: Data Column Sidecar Accepted
nodes.description: Sidecar has passed all gossip validation rules and is accepted for processing

nodes.label: Data Column Sidecar Rejected
nodes.description: Sidecar failed a REJECT validation rule and is discarded with potential peer penalty

nodes.label: Data Column Sidecar Ignored
nodes.description: Sidecar failed an IGNORE validation rule and is silently dropped without peer penalty

edges.label: Peer publishes data_column_sidecar on subnet topic
Slot is current or past → check finalization (rule 4)
Slot at or below finalized → IGNORE
Slot not higher than parent → REJECT
Duplicate valid sidecar for same tuple → IGNORE
All validation rules pass → accept sidecar

external_entities.name: Gossip Network Peer
external_entities.description: A peer node on the gossipsub network publishing data column sidecars on subnet topics

sub_graphs.title: Fulu P2P: Data Column Sidecar Request/Response Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the request/response networking protocols for retrieving data column sidecars (by range and by root), including serve range calculation, response ordering, and error handling.

nodes.label: DataColumnSidecarsByRange Request Received
nodes.description: Node receives a DataColumnSidecarsByRange request with (start_slot, count, columns) parameters

nodes.label: Compute Data Column Serve Range
nodes.description: Calculate data_column_serve_range = [max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), current_epoch]

nodes.label: Check Request Within Serve Range
nodes.description: Verify the requested slot range overlaps with the data_column_serve_range

nodes.label: Retrieve Data Columns for Range
nodes.description: Fetch data column sidecars from local storage for requested (slot, column_index) combinations within the serve range

nodes.label: Order Response by (slot, column_index)
nodes.description: Sort response sidecars in ascending (slot, column_index) order as required by protocol

nodes.label: Range Response Streamed
nodes.description: Response chunks have been streamed back to requesting peer in correct order

nodes.label: DataColumnSidecarsByRoot Request Received
nodes.description: Node receives a DataColumnSidecarsByRoot request with list of (block_root, columns) identifiers

nodes.label: Compute Minimum Request Epoch
nodes.description: Calculate minimum_request_epoch = max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH)

nodes.label: Check Block Epoch Eligibility
nodes.description: For each block_root, verify the block epoch >= minimum_request_epoch

nodes.label: ResourceUnavailable Error Sent
nodes.description: Error code 3 (ResourceUnavailable) returned for blocks earlier than minimum_request_epoch

nodes.label: Retrieve Data Columns by Root
nodes.description: Fetch data column sidecars from local storage for the requested block roots and column indices

nodes.label: Ensure Response Passes Gossip Validation
nodes.description: Only respond with sidecars that pass gossip validation rules; never send sidecars from blocks failing gossip or state transition validation

nodes.label: Root Response Streamed
nodes.description: Valid data column sidecars streamed back to requesting peer

nodes.label: Enforce MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS
nodes.description: Ensure no more than MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS items are returned in a single response

edges.label: Determine what range this node can serve
Compare requested range against serve range
Request entirely outside serve range → error
Request within serve range → retrieve columns
Check each block root against minimum epoch
Block too old → ResourceUnavailable error code 3
Verify retrieved sidecars pass gossip validation

external_entities.name: Requesting Peer Node
external_entities.description: A peer node sending DataColumnSidecarsByRange or DataColumnSidecarsByRoot requests via the Req/Resp protocol

sub_graphs.title: Fulu P2P: Distributed Blob Publishing and Local EL Retrieval
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundary between the consensus layer and execution layer for blob retrieval, and the distributed publishing flow where locally-retrieved blobs are converted to data columns and propagated.

nodes.label: Valid Beacon Block or Data Column Sidecar Received via Gossip
nodes.description: A valid beacon_block or data_column_sidecar has been received from gossip, triggering local EL blob query

nodes.label: Query engine_getBlobsV2
nodes.description: Send engine_getBlobsV2 request to local execution layer to retrieve blobs matching kzg_commitments from the block

nodes.label: All Blobs Retrieved from Local EL
nodes.description: All blobs matching kzg_commitments have been successfully retrieved from the local execution layer

nodes.label: Partial or No Blobs Available Locally
nodes.description: Not all blobs were available from the local execution layer

nodes.label: Convert Blobs to Data Columns
nodes.description: Transform locally-retrieved blobs into data column sidecars using erasure coding

nodes.label: Import Data Columns as if from Gossip
nodes.description: Import the locally-produced data columns with full gossip-equivalent behavior: update anti-equivocation cache and conditionally publish

nodes.label: Update Anti-Equivocation Cache
nodes.description: Record the (slot, proposer_index, column_index) tuple to prevent accepting duplicate/equivocating sidecars

nodes.label: Publish Data Column Sidecar if Subscribed
nodes.description: Publish data_column_sidecar on gossip subnet if and only if the node is subscribed to that subnet (via custody or sampling)

nodes.label: Data Columns Propagated to Network
nodes.description: Locally-produced data columns have been published to the appropriate gossip subnets

edges.label: Valid beacon_block or data_column_sidecar arrives via gossip
Query local execution layer for blobs
Convert all blobs to data columns (skip verification for local blobs)
Publish only if node is subscribed to subnet
Data columns published on gossip subnets
Trusted local EL provides blobs (verification skipped)

external_entities.name: Gossip Network
external_entities.description: The gossipsub network delivering beacon blocks and data column sidecars

external_entities.name: Local Execution Layer Client
external_entities.description: Co-located execution layer client providing blob data via engine_getBlobsV2 API; treated as trusted source

sub_graphs.title: Fulu P2P: Peer Discovery, Custody Groups, and Supernode Requirements
sub_graphs.description: Models peer discovery via ENR fields, custody group advertisement, supernode thresholds, and peer scoring based on custody obligations.

nodes.label: Node ENR Published with Fulu Fields
nodes.description: Node has published its ENR containing eth2 fork digest, cgc (custody_group_count), and nfd (next_fork_digest) fields

nodes.label: Evaluate Peer ENR Fields
nodes.description: Parse peer ENR: check eth2 fork digest, nfd field for fork compatibility, and cgc field for custody group count

nodes.label: Check Peer Custody Requirement
nodes.description: Verify peer's custody_group_count >= CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT; MAY reject peers with insufficient custody

nodes.label: Check Supernode Threshold
nodes.description: Determine if node must be supernode: combined validator balance >= 4096 ETH requires supernode status

nodes.label: Supernode Active
nodes.description: Node operates as supernode: subscribed to ALL data column sidecar subnets, custodies all columns, performs reconstruction and cross-seeding

nodes.label: Regular Node Active with Custody Subset
nodes.description: Node operates with standard custody obligations, subscribed to assigned subnet subset

nodes.label: Evaluate Fork Compatibility via nfd
nodes.description: Compare peer's nfd (next fork digest) with local expectations; MUST NOT disconnect before fork boundary, MAY disconnect at/after

nodes.label: Score Peer on Custody Compliance
nodes.description: Monitor whether peer responds to requests for its custodied columns; downscore or disconnect non-compliant peers

nodes.label: Peer Connected and Validated
nodes.description: Peer has been validated for fork compatibility and custody adequacy; connection maintained

nodes.label: Peer Rejected or Disconnected
nodes.description: Peer rejected due to insufficient custody, fork incompatibility, or non-compliance

edges.label: Peer discovered via discv5 with ENR
Parse ENR fields for fork and custody info
Check fork digest and nfd compatibility
Fork compatible → check custody group count

external_entities.name: discv5 Discovery Network
external_entities.description: The discovery v5 protocol used to find peers and exchange ENR records

external_entities.name: Local Validator Set
external_entities.description: The set of validators managed by this node, whose combined balance determines supernode requirement

sub_graphs.title: Fulu P2P: Fork Transition and Protocol Deprecation
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions during the Fulu fork activation, including blob sidecar deprecation, data column activation, and backward-compatible serving during the transition period.

nodes.label: Pre-Fulu: Blob Sidecars Active
nodes.description: System is before FULU_FORK_EPOCH; BlobSidecarsByRange and BlobSidecarsByRoot are active protocols

nodes.label: Fulu Fork Epoch Reached
nodes.description: Current epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH; data column protocols activate, blob sidecar topics deprecated

nodes.label: Activate Data Column Req/Resp Protocols
nodes.description: Enable DataColumnSidecarsByRange and DataColumnSidecarsByRoot req/resp protocols

nodes.label: Subscribe to Data Column Gossip Subnets
nodes.description: Subscribe to data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} topics based on custody assignments; unsubscribe from blob_sidecar_{subnet_id}

nodes.label: Transition Period: Blob Backward Compat Active
nodes.description: Period [FULU_FORK_EPOCH, FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS) where blob sidecar req/resp is still served for pre-Fulu range

nodes.label: Serve Blob Sidecars for Pre-Fulu Range
nodes.description: Respond to BlobSidecarsByRange/Root with sidecars from [min(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), FULU_FORK_EPOCH)

nodes.label: Blob Sidecar Protocols Fully Deprecated
nodes.description: Epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS; BlobSidecarsByRange and BlobSidecarsByRoot no longer served

nodes.label: Backfill Data Column Database
nodes.description: Clients bootstrapping from weak subjectivity checkpoint must backfill data columns to at least data_column_serve_range for compliance

nodes.label: Data Column Protocols Fully Operational
nodes.description: Node is fully serving data column sidecars across the complete data_column_serve_range

edges.label: Continue serving blob sidecars for pre-Fulu range on request
Nodes bootstrapping must backfill data columns

ambiguities.text: Clients MAY limit the number of data column sidecars in the response but MUST respond with at least the first blob-carrying block's sidecars if they have them.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that 'first blob-carrying block' means the block with the lowest slot in the requested range that contains non-zero blobs. The MAY limit implies implementations can return fewer than requested as long as they include at least one complete block's worth of sidecars.

ambiguities.text: The specification states clients MAY reject peers with custody_group_count less than CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT but does not specify the value of CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT itself in this document.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT is defined in the Fulu beacon chain spec (not the P2P spec). The MAY language means implementations are not strictly required to reject, which could lead to inconsistent enforcement across clients.

ambiguities.text: For rule 13, if the proposer cannot be immediately verified, the sidecar MAY be queued for later processing instead of being REJECTed.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that 'queued for later processing' means the sidecar is held in a temporary buffer until the shuffling context becomes available (e.g., after parent block processing). This creates a potential resource exhaustion vector if an attacker sends many sidecars with unverifiable proposer indices.

ambiguities.text: Honest nodes SHOULD query engine_getBlobsV2 - the SHOULD language leaves it ambiguous whether this is functionally required for network health or merely a performance optimization.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is critical for distributed blob publishing and data availability. Nodes that skip this step may reduce network-wide column availability. Treat as functionally required for security analysis.

ambiguities.text: The specification says to skip verification of locally-retrieved blobs from engine_getBlobsV2 but does not specify what happens if the EL returns corrupted or malicious blob data.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the local EL is fully trusted. If the EL is compromised, corrupted data columns would be produced and propagated to the network. This is a critical trust boundary assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: The local execution layer client (engine_getBlobsV2) is trusted to return correct blob data. Verification is explicitly skipped for locally-retrieved blobs.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised or buggy execution layer client could cause the consensus layer to produce and propagate invalid data columns to the network, potentially causing data availability failures or consensus splits.

implicit_assumptions.description: The network will have enough supernodes (hundreds) to ensure data column reconstruction is viable. At minimum one supernode must be available for reconstruction.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If insufficient supernodes exist, data columns may become unavailable for reconstruction, leading to data availability failures and potential finality stalls.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot create valid KZG proofs for arbitrary column data without possessing the original blob data, due to the binding property of KZG commitments.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could forge data column sidecars that pass all validation checks but contain incorrect data, breaking the data availability guarantee.

implicit_assumptions.description: Clients bootstrapping from a weak subjectivity checkpoint will backfill their data column database to at least data_column_serve_range before being expected to serve requests.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incompletely synced nodes would be unable to serve DataColumnSidecarsByRange requests, potentially being banned by peers and reducing network data availability capacity.

implicit_assumptions.description: The anti-equivocation cache is correctly maintained for locally-imported data columns (not just gossip-received ones), preventing equivocation attacks via the local EL path.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Equivocating proposers could bypass detection by having their conflicting sidecars imported via the local EL path on different nodes, leading to different nodes accepting different versions of the same column.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot send enough unverifiable-proposer sidecars to exhaust the queue buffer implied by rule 13's MAY-queue provision.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Resource exhaustion attack: attacker floods sidecars referencing unknown parents, causing unbounded memory growth in the queue buffer across all validating nodes.
